profile_overlay.changes: Overlay removes newer pin diagnostics/metadata and adapts old batch schema. Actual stat parser, sample filter, perf commands, measured-client wrapping and symbol capture are AST-identical; profiled_session/main also differ in unavailable optional branches and provider metadata.

limits: One stat and one record observation per source, sequential same boot, no randomized/repeated A/B. Diagnostic timings are not nano performance acceptance.

Stat counts cover measured client plus inherited workers, including startup/collection; record comparison filters rb_worker on CPUs0..19 in a settled full-cohort subwindow. They are separate invocations and cannot be merged.

Primary sampled-period/op denominator is batched progress delta between two captured snapshots within each arm own settled window. Snapshot skew/publication lag makes it approximate, not service/acquisition latency.
cycles:k frequency sampling may skid. Register-operation sample after a load is instruction-neighborhood evidence, not a measured cache miss or load latency.
Flat symbol counts exclude callees. Region boundaries are manual source/disassembly mapping, not a causal additive performance model.
The more complex state/budget spin loop can affect whole-client instruction counts; this profile does not attribute retired instruction deltas to specific functions.
READY-line prefetch is a bounded separate hypothesis. Samples at READY tests do not prove their remote loads explain the regression.
Generic cache-misses are not a cache-line-specific event and cannot confirm or refute the notification-line hypothesis.
Whole-client context switches include startup/collection and are not parking counts.

conclusions: Candidate stat cycles per completed operation rises14.08% and instructions42.80%; generic cache misses per operation falls5.20%. These whole-client counts do not isolate combiner work or parking.

Progress-aligned aggregate sampled period/op rises9.78%. Almost all net flat-symbol growth is in the origin slowpath: +873.87 out of the aggregate+876.04. Waiting amplification can be caused by slower execution elsewhere; this does not identify the initiating bottleneck.

execute_cs sampled period/op falls3.49%; run_combiner rises43.41% from82.06 to117.69, an absolute35.62. Source-level ownership-check duplication cannot be declared the dominant regression from these observations.

Shared initial owner/gate and frame-retirement owner regions do not increase. New READY admission/test and completion/test neighborhoods are observed at17.90 and18.20 period/op; they remain useful bounded prefetch hypotheses, not measured load latency.

Baseline spin loop is PAUSE/load/test/branch; candidate adds state validation and initial-budget bookkeeping. That is a concrete source/code difference consistent with higher retired instructions, but no per-function instruction counter attributes the1050 instructions/op increase to it.
